About.title: About us
About.p1After: —turning charts and rules into leveled, measurable learning. We believe trading skill can be “leveled up” like a game—through structured lessons, drills, and instant feedback, learners build execution and risk habits in a low‑risk environment.
About.p2After: : visible progress and tangible wins so every practice session has direction—whether you’re new or leveling up.
About.teamBody: Our core team blends traders, educators, and product builders—continuously iterating on content and drill tools. We value review culture, risk boundaries, and execution—we don’t promise get‑rich shortcuts; we teach repeatable training methods.
About.complianceText: This simulation system is built for investor education and training only. It does not provide investment advice, does not support live trading, and does not induce account opening, discretionary management, or any other activities within securities-regulated business scope.
